## Contribution type

- [ ] Lean declaration or proof
- [ ] Teaching or documentation correction
- [ ] Community lemma packet
- [ ] Harness, website, or governance tooling

## Mathematical result

Describe the source, exact claim, assumptions, and relationship to existing
BanditRLlib declarations.

## Verification

- [ ] Plain-English, LaTeX, and Lean statements describe the same claim.
- [ ] `python tools/bandit.py check` passes when Lean code changes.
- [ ] `python website/scripts/check_site.py` passes when the site changes.
- [ ] Status matches compiler and review evidence.
- [ ] Contributor credit and source provenance are complete.
- [ ] I license my intentional contribution under MIT.
- [ ] No credentials, private review material, or sensitive information is included.
